meta.title: Optimize VM pure call folding
meta.body_summary: Fold user-defined pure function calls at compile time using the VM's constant evaluator to eliminate runtime overhead, with a new test for folding in the presence of a global constant.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit self-merge by tamnd; adds constant folding optimization with test snapshots but no performance benchmark or review discussion.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 98 changed lines, this is a small change. It fits a low-risk compiler optimization, and the immediate self-merge without review is consistent with a small-scope performance improvement.

review_details.performance_claim: Fold pure function calls at compile time using constant evaluator to eliminate runtime overhead.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Small compiler optimization self-merged by maintainer without any review; illustrates that for trusted contributors, agent-authored changes can bypass review processes entirely when scope is low.

detection_detail.code_reading: No review or code-reading feedback present in the dataset.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Test output files show IR before/after folding, but no runtime performance measurements are provided; one test suite (TPCH) fails due to timeout, indicating incomplete coverage.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; PR merged immediately.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, added logic to fold pure user-defined function calls at compile time using the existing constant evaluator; updated test snapshots and added new test cases for pure and pure_global folding.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most changed files are test snapshots reflecting the constant folding optimization; the core change is 44 lines in vm.go.
change_trajectory: Single commit (fa45f3f): Implement pure call folding in VM compiler and update/add test files to reflect expected IR output.
